title: How to Write Blog Posts that Developers Read
summary: Six techniques for developer-audience blog posts: getting to the point, broadening scope, planning distribution, visuals, skimmable structure, and actionable takeaways.
when-to-read: Read when planning or writing a technical blog post aimed at developer readership, or diagnosing why existing content underperforms. Do not read for internal product or API documentation conventions (see how-to-write-better-documentation) — this is about public content aimed at an external audience.
